title: A raid for an army
text:
Cinderhold is now tuned for 10 to 20 heroes.

• Cinderhold is built for 10 to 20 heroes: its bosses now last about twice as long as before and hit 25% harder. Smaller groups can still go in to explore, but the bosses no longer go easier on them
• Groups of more than 15 heroes spread the fight further: the bosses take a little less damage per hero, so a full 20 still has to work for it
